summary: FF EAI Robotics Ecosystem Inc., formerly AIxCrypto Holdings, agreed on October 12, 2026 to acquire the robotics business of majority stockholder Faraday Future Intelligent Electric via a stock-and-preferred equity exchange, followed by a merger of RobotCo into a wholly owned subsidiary. A special committee of independent directors Chen Shi and Jason E. Dodier unanimously approved and recommended the related-party deal; advisor Advanture Capital Solutions LLC delivered a fairness opinion. Exact price per share, consideration mix, and ownership split were not quantified in the excerpt, leaving dilution, the related-party overhang, and post-close governance as the key risk-arb items.
